name: Poludnitsa
subtitle: Lady Midday
lore: The name of Lady Midday is spoken with reverence and fear by field-workers. As protector goddess of crops and of custom, she strikes down, with heat or sickle, those who work when it is time to rest, or otherwise flout tradition. She cares little that other realms practice customs different from Vyraj’s, and now takes out her wrath on other pantheons’ worshipers.
